introduction: I'm a final-year Information Technology student with a strong passion for Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and modern application development. I enjoy designing scalable software solutions, building clean architectures, and transforming ideas into real-world products.

My primary focus is ASP.NET Core, Flutter, SQL Server, Firebase, and AI integration using Large Language Models. Through academic projects, internships, and team leadership experience, I've developed practical skills in software architecture, backend development, mobile applications, and AI-powered systems. I was selected for the Vingroup AI20K Training Program and am interning as an AI Engineering Intern at VinRobotics (October – December 2026).
about.career_objective: Software Engineer with a strong interest in AI Engineering and AI Applications, focusing on developing intelligent applications, LLM-powered solutions, RAG systems, AI Agents, and practical AI-driven products. My goal is to contribute to innovative software products while growing through the Vingroup AI20K Training Program and my internship at VinRobotics.
